title: a bug ticket casts carrying fixes, the proofs whose red it fixes
intention: The store charter declares and shapes fixes as a plan field, so cast_ticket admits a bug ticket naming the proofs whose red it fixes and refuses a malformed fixes by name.
why: Measured 2026-11-12: cast_ticket over a scratch store refused a bug doc with 'fixes is not a plan, state or log field' and cast the same doc without fixes. The fixit rule reads that field in two places, reseal.py:430 (rung 4, path y, ticket e8be83a46ea9) and clearance.py:534 (the BUILDME fixit rule), as outline 17.11.7.2 asks ('at BUILDME the ticket names the red it fixes'). The store charter's field split (284798998ab0, 2026-10-29) predates the field, and nothing added it since. So no real ticket can carry it: both readers' proofs write ticket fixtures straight to disk, past the door, and cc_0 had to recast 24f60e45304c as a code-seam to get through path x. The charter is the wrong side; the readers match the outline.
traces_to: Law 4 (the fixit rule is physics in reseal and clearance, but the door in front of them refuses the field they read, so it only ever ran on fixtures) and Law 8 (a fixit's entry is the red it names, so the red has to be nameable).
how: D1: through the artifact door (verb cast), append 'fixes' to plan_fields in /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/tickets/_charter+why.json and add plan_shapes.fixes = {"lists_of": "non-blank path string", "min_items": 1, "resolves": true}, as cd8a1de6139c added chart. D2: _shape_lacks in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py, beside its bounds and measured blocks, refuses a present fixes that is not a list, is empty, has a blank entry, or names a path that resolves to no file (relative paths against the cairn root, absolute accepted), each lack naming fixes. No requirement at cast: clearance's BUILDME rule already demands fixes on a bug at the crossing. D3: red-first proof over a scratch commons, the pattern of skills/sorted/proofs/test_sorted_instructs_the_shaped_plan.py.

clauses.claim: a bug doc whose fixes is a non-empty list of repo-relative paths to existing files casts, and read_ticket over the cast plan returns that list unchanged
fixes that is not a list, an empty list, a list with a blank entry, or a list naming a path that resolves to no file is refused with a lack naming fixes, and nothing is written
the live store charter declares fixes in plan_fields and shapes it in plan_shapes
the same doc without fixes still casts

decisions.text: D1: the store charter declares fixes in plan_fields and shapes it in plan_shapes, written through the artifact door with verb cast.
D2: _shape_lacks refuses a malformed fixes, naming it; a well-shaped one passes.
D3: the proof, one tooth per clause, casting into a scratch commons whose charter is copied from the live one.
